from pathlib import Path


def replace_once(text, old, new, label):
    count = text.count(old)
    if count != 1:
        raise SystemExit(f"{label}: expected exactly one match, found {count}")
    return text.replace(old, new, 1)


code_path = Path("golang/server/code_symbol.go")
code = code_path.read_text()
code = replace_once(
    code,
    '''\treferences        []string // CodeSymbol ids this symbol references (calls/uses), incl. external:<name>\n\tknownCallers      []string // inbound static aw:references sites from the current graph\n\ttargeted          bool     // true only when the task names this symbol exactly\n''',
    '''\treferences        []string // CodeSymbol ids this symbol references (calls/uses), incl. external:<name>\n\tlookupIDs         []string // equivalent graph identities whose evidence belongs to this symbol\n\tknownCallers      []string // inbound static aw:references sites from the current graph\n\ttargeted          bool     // true only when the task names this symbol exactly\n''',
    "lookup identity field",
)
code = replace_once(
    code,
    '''func focusCodeSymbolsForTask(task string, syms []codeSymbol) []codeSymbol {\n\tif strings.TrimSpace(task) == "" || len(syms) == 0 {\n\t\treturn syms\n\t}\n''',
    '''func focusCodeSymbolsForTask(task string, syms []codeSymbol) []codeSymbol {\n\tsyms = reconcileEquivalentCodeSymbols(syms)\n\tif strings.TrimSpace(task) == "" || len(syms) == 0 {\n\t\treturn syms\n\t}\n''',
    "reconcile before focus",
)
old_candidates = '''func codeSymbolCandidateNames(sym codeSymbol) []string {
\tvar names []string
\tif name := strings.TrimSpace(sym.label); name != "" && name != sym.id {
\t\tnames = append(names, name)
\t}
\tif colon := strings.LastIndex(sym.id, ":"); colon >= 0 && colon+1 < len(sym.id) {
\t\tname := strings.TrimSpace(sym.id[colon+1:])
\t\tif name != "" {
\t\t\tnames = appendUniqueStr(names, name)
\t\t}
\t}
\treturn names
}
'''
new_candidates = '''func codeSymbolCandidateNames(sym codeSymbol) []string {
\tvar names []string
\tfor _, name := range codeSymbolDirectNames(sym) {
\t\tnames = appendUniqueStr(names, name)
\t\tif leaf := codeSymbolLeafName(name); leaf != name {
\t\t\tnames = appendUniqueStr(names, leaf)
\t\t}
\t}
\treturn names
}

func codeSymbolDirectNames(sym codeSymbol) []string {
\tvar names []string
\tif name := strings.TrimSpace(sym.label); name != "" && name != sym.id {
\t\tnames = appendUniqueStr(names, name)
\t}
\tif colon := strings.LastIndex(sym.id, ":"); colon >= 0 && colon+1 < len(sym.id) {
\t\tif name := strings.TrimSpace(sym.id[colon+1:]); name != "" {
\t\t\tnames = appendUniqueStr(names, name)
\t\t}
\t}
\treturn names
}

func codeSymbolLeafName(name string) string {
\tname = strings.TrimSpace(name)
\tif dot := strings.LastIndex(name, "."); dot >= 0 && dot+1 < len(name) {
\t\treturn name[dot+1:]
\t}
\treturn name
}

func codeSymbolFileKey(id string) string {
\tif colon := strings.LastIndex(id, ":"); colon >= 0 {
\t\treturn id[:colon]
\t}
\treturn id
}

// reconcileEquivalentCodeSymbols joins the annotated semantic node and the
// SCIP structural node only when identity is unambiguous inside one file.
// The canonical symbol retains every graph id as a lookup alias, so evidence
// and inbound references attached to either representation remain visible.
func reconcileEquivalentCodeSymbols(syms []codeSymbol) []codeSymbol {
\tout := append([]codeSymbol(nil), syms...)
\tremoved := make([]bool, len(out))
\tfor i := range out {
\t\tif len(out[i].lookupIDs) == 0 {
\t\t\tout[i].lookupIDs = []string{out[i].id}
\t\t}
\t}

\texactQualified := map[string][]int{}
\tfor i, sym := range out {
\t\tfor _, name := range codeSymbolDirectNames(sym) {
\t\t\tif strings.Contains(name, ".") {
\t\t\t\tkey := codeSymbolFileKey(sym.id) + "\\x00" + name
\t\t\t\texactQualified[key] = append(exactQualified[key], i)
\t\t\t}
\t\t}
\t}
\tfor _, idxs := range exactQualified {
\t\tif len(idxs) < 2 {
\t\t\tcontinue
\t\t}
\t\tdst := idxs[0]
\t\tfor _, src := range idxs[1:] {
\t\t\tmergeEquivalentCodeSymbol(&out[dst], out[src])
\t\t\tremoved[src] = true
\t\t}
\t}

\tqualifiedByLeaf := map[string][]int{}
\tfor i, sym := range out {
\t\tif removed[i] {
\t\t\tcontinue
\t\t}
\t\tseen := map[string]bool{}
\t\tfor _, name := range codeSymbolDirectNames(sym) {
\t\t\tif !strings.Contains(name, ".") {
\t\t\t\tcontinue
\t\t\t}
\t\t\tkey := codeSymbolFileKey(sym.id) + "\\x00" + codeSymbolLeafName(name)
\t\t\tif !seen[key] {
\t\t\t\tqualifiedByLeaf[key] = append(qualifiedByLeaf[key], i)
\t\t\t\tseen[key] = true
\t\t\t}
\t\t}
\t}
\tfor i, sym := range out {
\t\tif removed[i] {
\t\t\tcontinue
\t\t}
\t\tvar bareLeaves []string
\t\tfor _, name := range codeSymbolDirectNames(sym) {
\t\t\tif !strings.Contains(name, ".") {
\t\t\t\tbareLeaves = appendUniqueStr(bareLeaves, name)
\t\t\t}
\t\t}
\t\tfor _, leaf := range bareLeaves {
\t\t\tcandidates := qualifiedByLeaf[codeSymbolFileKey(sym.id)+"\\x00"+leaf]
\t\t\tif len(candidates) != 1 || candidates[0] == i {
\t\t\t\tcontinue
\t\t\t}
\t\t\tmergeEquivalentCodeSymbol(&out[candidates[0]], out[i])
\t\t\tremoved[i] = true
\t\t\tbreak
\t\t}
\t}

\tresult := make([]codeSymbol, 0, len(out))
\tfor i := range out {
\t\tif removed[i] {
\t\t\tcontinue
\t\t}
\t\tsort.Strings(out[i].lookupIDs)
\t\tsort.Strings(out[i].implements)
\t\tsort.Strings(out[i].enforces)
\t\tsort.Strings(out[i].protects)
\t\tsort.Strings(out[i].partiallyViolates)
\t\tsort.Strings(out[i].testedBy)
\t\tsort.Strings(out[i].references)
\t\tresult = append(result, out[i])
\t}
\tsort.Slice(result, func(i, j int) bool { return result[i].id < result[j].id })
\treturn result
}

func mergeEquivalentCodeSymbol(dst *codeSymbol, src codeSymbol) {
\tif dst.label == "" || (!strings.Contains(dst.label, ".") && strings.Contains(src.label, ".")) {
\t\tdst.label = src.label
\t}
\tif dst.component == "" {
\t\tdst.component = src.component
\t}
\tif dst.namespace == "" {
\t\tdst.namespace = src.namespace
\t}
\tif dst.language == "" {
\t\tdst.language = src.language
\t}
\tif dst.risk == "" {
\t\tdst.risk = src.risk
\t}
\tfor _, id := range append([]string{src.id}, src.lookupIDs...) {
\t\tif id != "" {
\t\t\tdst.lookupIDs = appendUniqueStr(dst.lookupIDs, id)
\t\t}
\t}
\tfor _, value := range src.implements {
\t\tdst.implements = appendUniqueStr(dst.implements, value)
\t}
\tfor _, value := range src.enforces {
\t\tdst.enforces = appendUniqueStr(dst.enforces, value)
\t}
\tfor _, value := range src.protects {
\t\tdst.protects = appendUniqueStr(dst.protects, value)
\t}
\tfor _, value := range src.partiallyViolates {
\t\tdst.partiallyViolates = appendUniqueStr(dst.partiallyViolates, value)
\t}
\tfor _, value := range src.testedBy {
\t\tdst.testedBy = appendUniqueStr(dst.testedBy, value)
\t}
\tfor _, value := range src.references {
\t\tdst.references = appendUniqueStr(dst.references, value)
\t}
}
'''
code = replace_once(code, old_candidates, new_candidates, "candidate aliases and reconciliation")
old_attach = '''func (s *server) attachKnownStaticCallers(ctx context.Context, syms []codeSymbol) ([]codeSymbol, error) {
\tout := append([]codeSymbol(nil), syms...)
\tfor i := range out {
\t\tif !out[i].targeted {
\t\t\tcontinue
\t\t}
\t\tsymbolID := rdf.DecodeIRIPath(out[i].id)
\t\tcallers, err := s.referencingSites(ctx, symbolID)
\t\tif err != nil {
\t\t\treturn nil, err
\t\t}
\t\tout[i].knownCallers = callers
\t}
\treturn out, nil
}
'''
new_attach = '''func (s *server) attachKnownStaticCallers(ctx context.Context, syms []codeSymbol, scope string) ([]codeSymbol, error) {
\tout := append([]codeSymbol(nil), syms...)
\tfor i := range out {
\t\tif !out[i].targeted {
\t\t\tcontinue
\t\t}
\t\tlookupIDs := append([]string(nil), out[i].lookupIDs...)
\t\tif len(lookupIDs) == 0 {
\t\t\tlookupIDs = []string{out[i].id}
\t\t}
\t\tvar callers []string
\t\tfor _, lookupID := range lookupIDs {
\t\t\tsites, err := s.referencingSitesInScope(ctx, rdf.DecodeIRIPath(lookupID), scope)
\t\t\tif err != nil {
\t\t\t\treturn nil, err
\t\t\t}
\t\t\tfor _, site := range sites {
\t\t\t\tcallers = appendUniqueStr(callers, site)
\t\t\t}
\t\t}
\t\tsort.Strings(callers)
\t\tout[i].knownCallers = callers
\t}
\treturn out, nil
}
'''
code = replace_once(code, old_attach, new_attach, "scoped alias caller lookup")
code_path.write_text(code)


brief_path = Path("golang/server/briefing.go")
brief = brief_path.read_text()
brief = replace_once(
    brief,
    '''\timpact = limitImpactResponseWithProfile(impact, profile)\n\tcodeSyms = focusCodeSymbolsForTask(task, codeSyms)\n\tcodeSyms, err = s.attachKnownStaticCallers(ctx, codeSyms)\n''',
    '''\timpact = limitImpactResponseWithProfile(impact, profile)\n\tsectionScope := briefingScope(requestedDomain, resolvedScope, s.homeDomain)\n\tcodeSyms = focusCodeSymbolsForTask(task, codeSyms)\n\tcodeSyms, err = s.attachKnownStaticCallers(ctx, codeSyms, sectionScope)\n''',
    "resolved scope caller lookup",
)
brief = replace_once(
    brief,
    '''\t// An unanchored file resolves to "", so fall back to the home domain.\n\tsectionScope := briefingScope(requestedDomain, resolvedScope, s.homeDomain)\n''',
    '''\t// An unanchored file resolves to "", so the already-computed sectionScope\n\t// falls back to the home domain.\n''',
    "remove duplicate section scope",
)
brief_path.write_text(brief)


ref_path = Path("golang/server/reference_sites.go")
refs = ref_path.read_text()
old_ref = '''func (s *server) referencingSites(ctx context.Context, symbolID string) ([]string, error) {
\tiri := mintedIRI(rdf.ClassCodeSymbol, symbolID)
\tinbound, err := s.store.DescribeInbound(ctx, iri)
\tif err != nil {
\t\treturn nil, status.Errorf(codes.Unavailable, "backend query failed: %v", err)
\t}
\tout := make([]string, 0, len(inbound))
\tseen := map[string]bool{}
\tfor _, t := range inbound {
\t\tif t.Predicate != rdf.PropReferences {
\t\t\tcontinue
\t\t}
\t\tsiteID, ok := codeSymbolIDFromIRI(t.Subject)
\t\tif !ok || siteID == symbolID || seen[siteID] {
\t\t\tcontinue
\t\t}
\t\tseen[siteID] = true
\t\tout = append(out, siteID)
\t}
\tsort.Strings(out)
\treturn out, nil
}
'''
new_ref = '''func (s *server) referencingSites(ctx context.Context, symbolID string) ([]string, error) {
\treturn s.referencingSitesInScope(ctx, symbolID, "")
}

// referencingSitesInScope preserves the resolved briefing domain all the way
// to inbound caller evidence. A multi-domain graph may contain identical raw
// file:symbol ids; callers outside the selected repository are never rendered
// as local architectural evidence. A store that cannot expose node domains
// fails closed for a scoped request rather than silently widening the query.
func (s *server) referencingSitesInScope(ctx context.Context, symbolID, scope string) ([]string, error) {
\tiri := mintedIRI(rdf.ClassCodeSymbol, symbolID)
\tinbound, err := s.store.DescribeInbound(ctx, iri)
\tif err != nil {
\t\treturn nil, status.Errorf(codes.Unavailable, "backend query failed: %v", err)
\t}
\tvar keep map[string]bool
\tscope = strings.TrimSpace(scope)
\tif scope != "" {
\t\tvar ok bool
\t\tkeep, ok = s.inScopeClassIRIs(ctx, rdf.ClassCodeSymbol, s.homeDomain, scope)
\t\tif !ok {
\t\t\treturn nil, status.Errorf(codes.Unavailable, "domain-scoped caller lookup is unavailable for %q", scope)
\t\t}
\t}
\tout := make([]string, 0, len(inbound))
\tseen := map[string]bool{}
\tfor _, t := range inbound {
\t\tif t.Predicate != rdf.PropReferences {
\t\t\tcontinue
\t\t}
\t\tif keep != nil && !keep[t.Subject] {
\t\t\tcontinue
\t\t}
\t\tsiteID, ok := codeSymbolIDFromIRI(t.Subject)
\t\tif !ok || siteID == symbolID || seen[siteID] {
\t\t\tcontinue
\t\t}
\t\tseen[siteID] = true
\t\tout = append(out, siteID)
\t}
\tsort.Strings(out)
\treturn out, nil
}
'''
refs = replace_once(refs, old_ref, new_ref, "domain-scoped reference sites")
ref_path.write_text(refs)


test_path = Path("golang/server/reference_sites_test.go")
tests = test_path.read_text()
addition = r'''

type domainAwareCallerStore struct {
	fakeStore
	domains map[string][]string
}

func (s *domainAwareCallerStore) ClassNodeDomains(_ context.Context, classIRI string) (map[string][]string, error) {
	if classIRI != rdf.ClassCodeSymbol {
		return map[string][]string{}, nil
	}
	out := make(map[string][]string, len(s.domains))
	for iri, domains := range s.domains {
		out[iri] = append([]string(nil), domains...)
	}
	return out, nil
}

func TestFocusCodeSymbols_ReconcilesAnnotatedAndSCIPTwin(t *testing.T) {
	intentIRI := mintedIRI(rdf.ClassIntent, "server.briefing_contract")
	syms := []codeSymbol{
		{id: "golang/server/briefing.go:Briefing", label: "Briefing", language: "go", references: []string{"external:context.Context"}},
		{id: "golang/server/briefing.go:server.Briefing", label: "server.Briefing", language: "go", implements: []string{intentIRI}},
	}
	focused := focusCodeSymbolsForTask("change server.Briefing behavior", syms)
	if len(focused) != 1 || !focused[0].targeted || focused[0].label != "server.Briefing" {
		t.Fatalf("focused twins = %+v, want one targeted server.Briefing", focused)
	}
	wantIDs := []string{"golang/server/briefing.go:Briefing", "golang/server/briefing.go:server.Briefing"}
	if !reflect.DeepEqual(focused[0].lookupIDs, wantIDs) {
		t.Fatalf("lookup aliases = %v, want %v", focused[0].lookupIDs, wantIDs)
	}
	if !reflect.DeepEqual(focused[0].implements, []string{intentIRI}) || !reflect.DeepEqual(focused[0].references, []string{"external:context.Context"}) {
		t.Fatalf("twin evidence was not merged: %+v", focused[0])
	}
}

func TestFocusCodeSymbols_UniqueQualifiedLeafAlias(t *testing.T) {
	syms := []codeSymbol{{id: "render/json.go:JSON.Render", label: "JSON.Render"}}
	focused := focusCodeSymbolsForTask("change Render behavior", syms)
	if len(focused) != 1 || !focused[0].targeted {
		t.Fatalf("unique leaf alias did not focus JSON.Render: %+v", focused)
	}

	ambiguous := []codeSymbol{
		{id: "render/json.go:JSON.Render", label: "JSON.Render"},
		{id: "render/json.go:AsciiJSON.Render", label: "AsciiJSON.Render"},
	}
	got := focusCodeSymbolsForTask("change Render behavior", ambiguous)
	if len(got) != 2 || got[0].targeted || got[1].targeted {
		t.Fatalf("ambiguous leaf alias must preserve unfocused context: %+v", got)
	}
}

func TestAttachKnownStaticCallers_UsesEquivalentLookupIDs(t *testing.T) {
	bareID := "golang/server/briefing.go:Briefing"
	qualifiedID := "golang/server/briefing.go:server.Briefing"
	callerID := "golang/server/api.go:callBriefing"
	s := newServer(fakeStore{
		describeInbound: func(_ context.Context, iri string) ([]store.InboundTriple, error) {
			if iri == mintedIRI(rdf.ClassCodeSymbol, bareID) {
				return []store.InboundTriple{inboundRef(callerID)}, nil
			}
			if iri == mintedIRI(rdf.ClassCodeSymbol, qualifiedID) {
				return nil, nil
			}
			t.Fatalf("unexpected caller lookup IRI %q", iri)
			return nil, nil
		},
	})
	focused := focusCodeSymbolsForTask("change server.Briefing", []codeSymbol{
		{id: bareID, label: "Briefing"},
		{id: qualifiedID, label: "server.Briefing"},
	})
	got, err := s.attachKnownStaticCallers(context.Background(), focused, "")
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if len(got) != 1 || !reflect.DeepEqual(got[0].knownCallers, []string{callerID}) {
		t.Fatalf("alias caller evidence = %+v, want %q", got, callerID)
	}
}

func TestReferencingSitesInScope_ExcludesForeignDomainCallers(t *testing.T) {
	const localDomain = "github.com/example/local"
	const foreignDomain = "github.com/example/foreign"
	targetID := "pkg/x.go:Foo"
	localCaller := "local/use.go:callFoo"
	foreignCaller := "foreign/use.go:callFoo"
	store := &domainAwareCallerStore{
		fakeStore: fakeStore{
			describeInbound: func(_ context.Context, iri string) ([]store.InboundTriple, error) {
				if iri != mintedIRI(rdf.ClassCodeSymbol, targetID) {
					t.Fatalf("lookup IRI = %q", iri)
				}
				return []store.InboundTriple{inboundRef(localCaller), inboundRef(foreignCaller)}, nil
			},
		},
		domains: map[string][]string{
			mintedIRI(rdf.ClassCodeSymbol, localCaller):   {localDomain},
			mintedIRI(rdf.ClassCodeSymbol, foreignCaller): {foreignDomain},
		},
	}
	s := newServer(store)
	s.homeDomain = localDomain
	got, err := s.referencingSitesInScope(context.Background(), targetID, localDomain)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if !reflect.DeepEqual(got, []string{localCaller}) {
		t.Fatalf("scoped callers = %v, want only %q", got, localCaller)
	}
}
'''
if "TestFocusCodeSymbols_ReconcilesAnnotatedAndSCIPTwin" not in tests:
    tests += addition
test_path.write_text(tests)
